name: Midea Real Estate Holding Limited
summary: Midea Real Estate Holding Limited, an investment holding company, provides property management services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Project Management Services Business; Property Management Services Business; Asset Operation Business; and Real Estate Technology Business.
